lhs: Physical grouped one-tap convolution, exact conversions of unsigned operands to U32 then U64, U64 accumulation, clamp and final U32 store.
rhs: Transpose/convert operands to U32, broadcast kernel, multiply U32 and retain low word.
conditions: Dense one-spatial-axis kernel extent one, rank three with arbitrary independent dimension permutations, valid grouping, kernel input feature one and both input/output feature sizes equal group count. Unit strides/dilations and zero padding. Layout-insensitive mathematical profile.
overlap: Reuses independently checked physical addresses and exact Nat contraction. Earlier same-result U8 saturation counterexample has no operand conversions and a different result narrowing. Source-to-native reachability untested.
types: Both input operands U8; U32 result. The product is at most 65025.
